manage.title: Manage usage statistics
manage.description: See what usage statistics are sent, send them now and reset the instance ID.

enabled.label: Share anonymous usage statistics
enabled.description: Sends a small anonymous summary once a day to help improve Termix. It never includes usernames, hostnames, IP addresses or credentials.

includePlatform.label: Include platform info
includePlatform.description: The operating system, CPU architecture, Node.js version, database type and how Termix is installed (Docker, desktop app or server).

includeFeatureUsage.label: Include feature usage
includeFeatureUsage.description: How many times each kind of tab was opened and how many SSH logins happened since the last report. Users can turn off their own part in their profile.

includePlugins.label: Include installed features
includePlugins.description: Which built-in features are installed and running.

shareFeatureUsage.label: Include my feature usage
shareFeatureUsage.description: Counts which kinds of tabs you open in the anonymous usage statistics. Nothing about you or your hosts is sent.

status.title: Status
status.on: Sharing usage statistics once a day
status.lockedOn: Turned on by the ENABLE_TELEMETRY environment variable. Change it there.
status.lockedOff: Turned off by the ENABLE_TELEMETRY environment variable. Change it there.
status.notSent: Usage statistics are turned off, nothing was sent
status.resetIdConfirm: Reset the instance ID? Future reports will look like a new install.
status.previewDescription: This is exactly what would be sent right now.
status.loadFailed: Could not load the usage statistics status
